externalReferences.title: Ofqual mathematics grade descriptors
externalReferences.use: Grade 5 routine procedures versus grade 8 substantial reasoning and non-obvious connections; describes overall student performance, not individual item grades.

externalReferences.title: AQA 8300 assessment objectives
externalReferences.use: Distinguish standard techniques from reasoning/problem solving; MCQ recognition does not demonstrate written argument.

externalReferences.title: AQA 8300 algebra
externalReferences.use: Algebra topic anchors; Higher-only extensions do not confirm school taught scope.

rubric.nonroutine: Choose or link methods beyond a predictable procedure, handle distinct constraints, complete solution sets or non-obvious transfers. Provisional author judgement, not certified grade.
rubric.routine: Familiar prescribed method or recognition shortcut; benchmark only under strict grade 7+ policy pending reviewer acceptance.
rubric.scope: All items require taught-topic confirmation; additional prerequisite flags conservative, not assertions content is untaught.
rubric.credit: Broad conservative cross-topic exclusion groups, not final mastery taxonomy. Local family retained; further overlap can exist.

releaseDecision: BLOCKED. Prioritise nonroutine pool for final review; do not automatically rewrite all items again. Keep routine/borderline as diagnostic candidates outside grade7+ Daily pool. No credit or import until necessary approval and technical tests.
limitations: Latest actual stems and keys read for 200. No independent examiner or student dataset; no claim that every latest worked solution and all symbolic choices were freshly re-reviewed. Syllabus references are topic anchors. School-specific curriculum PDF not checked in accordance with previous instruction. All formal approval flags false.
